trap.label: turn out
trap.wrong: It turned out that he is right.
trap.right: It turned out that he was right.
trap.why: Em português “acabou que ele tem razão” aceita o presente. Em inglês, após turned out o verbo seguinte acompanha o passado da narrativa.

mcq.q: It turned out that she ___ right.

fix.wrong: It turned out that he comes.
fix.right: It turned out that he came.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “It turns out that she knows.”
rewrite.answer: It turned out that she knew.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com turn out + well: “The plan went well.”
